decisionId.description: Stable id of a recorded user tier/direction choice; paired with selectedOption.

selectedOption.description: Must equal state.json.choices[decisionId].selected; never an agent default.

goal.description: What this branch is for: doneWhen, the index of the one state.json.mission.doneWhen line whose evidence this branch produces (its producedBy is this operator), or prerequisite, the branch N/M this one enables. Required on every branch of a session that carries a mission (scripts/validate-request.mjs#branchGoalErrors); a branch that points at nothing does not run.

unit.description: The one unit this branch runs: an id of the units.json bound as inputs.units, which an earlier <domain>.plan branch produced (templates/kinds/units.schema.json). Required on a mission branch of an execute operator whose domain has a plan operator and whose done-when lines number more than one (scripts/validate-request.mjs#unitGateErrors); a blind agent takes one page, one modal, one flow.
